answer: Make each agent identity post a refundable stake and prove ongoing useful work before it can trade: like a river forced through one narrow gate, only identities that paid the bond and keep doing verifiable work flow through, while cheap copies stall at the gate. Fraud forfeits the stake, so an attacker creating thousands of fake identities pays thousands of bonds, and a Sybil spiral of free clones collapses because every onyx-dark ledger entry ties one costly identity to one real track record.
